title: Mediation Procedure Under Consumer Protection Act

content.scenario: Rahul, a consumer, purchased a defective smartphone from a retailer in Delhi. He filed a complaint with the District Commission, which referred the matter to mediation. The mediator, nominated by the Commission, considered the rights and obligations of the parties, the usages of trade, and the circumstances giving rise to the dispute.
content.outcome: The mediator carried out the mediation guided by the principles of natural justice and helped the parties reach a settlement. The terms of the agreement were reduced to writing and signed by the parties.
